[[File:Arrg chathead.png|left|80px]]
'''Arrg''' is a [[troll]] and partner of [[Aga]].{{CiteNPC |npc=Ug |quote=I love Aga, she so beautiful, she smell so nice, like rotting dead ice wolf! But Arrg... that arrrrrg! He together with Aga and he much stronger than Ug. He rip Ug apart! |loc=Troll Romance |name=love }} He actually has several troll girlfriends due to his size and strength,{{CiteNPC |npc=Arrg |quote=Arrg strong troll. Arrg mighty troll. Arrg have many girlfriends! |loc=Troll Romance }} but does not consider Aga's desire for love to be important,{{CiteNPC |npc=Arrg |quote=I no know, I just say to make Aga shut up! |loc=Troll Romance }} finding the concept confusing and irritating.{{CiteNPC |npc=Arrg |quote=This concept of 'love' confuses and infuriates Arrg. |loc=Troll Romance }} He has a [[Troll Romance]] rival for Aga's affections in the form of [[Ug]], a weaker troll.{{NamedRef|love}}

After Ug obtains a [[trollweiss]] flower to prove his love, Arrg must be fought and defeated. He uses [[melee]] and [[ranged]], both of which can hit up to 1,100, although the [[Fremennik round shield]] reduces the maximum damage from ranging. It is recommended to fight him with magic, using splitbark or better weapons and armour. He teleports the player to the [[Troll arena]] to fight.

It is best to use either the [[protect from Melee|protect from melee]] or [[protect from Missiles|ranged]] prayer against him and switch. After being defeated, he begs the player for mercy.{{CiteNPC |npc=Arrg |quote=Oh mighty man-warrior, please no hurt Arrg. |loc=Troll Romance }} Arrg is fightable as a class D boss monster in the [[Dominion Tower]] minigame if [[Troll Romance]] is complete.

Due to the troll naming method, he either ate something called "Arrg" or something that made the sound "Arrg", as trolls are named after the first thing they eat, or the first sound it makes if it has no known name.

==Trivia==
{{Listen
|title = Arrg's menacing voice
|align = right
|filename = Arrg.ogg
|desc = Kill silly human.}}
* Arrg used to have a combat level of 113, the same as that of the [[troll general]]s. His max hit and life points are also the same as those of the troll generals.
* Arrg's line "This concept of 'love' confuses and infuriates Arrg" is a reference to the animated series Futurama.
